notes: The blog index's 'Latest posts' list runs newest first: 'Announcing TypeScript 7.1 Beta' (Oct 20, 2026), 'Announcing TypeScript 7.0' (Jul 8, 2026), then 'Announcing TypeScript 7.0 RC' (Jun 18, 2026), which is not visited. One item per visited post, keyed by its h1 title as shown. Expected extraction per post: title plus the h2/h3 headings inside .entry-content. 7.1 Beta: Support for Import Attributes in Ambient Modules; Source Phase Imports; --target es2026; New Library Methods; TypeScript 7.1 API; Snapshots; File System APIs; Content Mappers; More on the API; Optimizations; Notable Behavioral Changes; lib.d.ts; Stronger Checks When Using Distributive Type Parameters; What’s Next? Changed since 2026-11-07: only the comment counts moved (7.1 Beta now has 6 comments, one new reply on Nov 9, 2026). The same two posts are newest and their headings are unchanged, so the items are the same; include/exclude are new in this file. Judgement call / grader weakness: the key 'Announcing TypeScript 7.0' is a substring of 'Announcing TypeScript 7.0 RC' and also appears in the 7.1 Beta page's 'Read next' block, so a run that wrongly visits the RC post, or keeps related posts, could still match it.
